## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.54% | 1M: +0.54%) and VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -12.00%) show mixed risk signals while sector breadth is narrow, supporting the neutral call.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Credit mixed: HYG in CORRECTION (1W: -0.48% | 1M: +0.28%) vs LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -0.42%) → ambiguous credit tone. Fear modestly lower via VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -12.00%), but very narrow sector participation constrains conviction.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Duration pressure visible: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -0.01%) indicating yields nudging up. Dollar and curves are neutral in the barometer, leaving financial conditions broadly balanced.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.37% | 1M: +10.17%) and Technology also positive: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +3.15%); most other sectors are weak (Financials XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -2.36% | 1M: -1.29%)). Style mixed / no clear leadership given the 2/11 breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US flat-to-slightly soft: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.54% | 1M: +0.54%). EM mixed: EEM in CORRECTION (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +3.81%) while China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -3.07%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculative ETFs show 1M strength but 1W weakness—IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -2.15% | 1M: +21.02%) and ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -3.81% | 1M: +12.97%)—suggesting profit-taking after rallies. Small caps weak: IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.89% | 1M: -1.91%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Commodity-linked ETFs are strong: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +15.46%), UGA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.70% | 1M: +17.88%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.55% | 1M: +16.16%). Precious metals in short-term pullback: GLD in CORRECTION (1W: -7.32% | 1M: +6.74%).

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy is a clear outperformer: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.37% | 1M: +10.17%) and natural gas UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.42% | 1M: +4.65%), backing commodity-driven cyclicals.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
Confirmed: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.37% | 1M: +10.17%) and XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +3.15%) show consistent 1W/1M strength. Divergences: GLD (1W: -7.32% | 1M: +6.74%), SLV (1W: -7.06% | 1M: +10.41%) and crypto IBIT (1W: -2.15% | 1M: +21.02%) are in CORRECTION; no MAJOR divergence across core ETFs (SPY/XLK/XLF/TLT).

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Maintain a neutral net stance; favor selective exposure to energy and commodity-linked ETFs (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.37% | 1M: +10.17%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +15.46%)) while monitoring tech momentum (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +3.15%)). Reduce exposure to rate-sensitive Financials and small caps (XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -2.36% | 1M: -1.29%), IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.89% | 1M: -1.91%)).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Energy — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.37% | 1M: +10.17%) if oil momentum continues. BEARISH: Precious metals — GLD in CORRECTION (1W: -7.32% | 1M: +6.74%) if profit-taking extends.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Crude/energy — USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +15.46%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.55% | 1M: +16.16%). BEARISH: Gold/silver pullbacks — GLD CORRECTION (1W: -7.32% | 1M: +6.74%), SLV CORRECTION (1W: -7.06% | 1M: +10.41%).

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX 20 — watch complacency; VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -12.00%). HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 for credit health; HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.48% | 1M: +0.28%) vs LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -0.42%). XLK/XLF rotation breakpoint to monitor for style shifts given XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +3.15%) and XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -2.36% | 1M: -1.29%).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive, narrow leadership driving a neutral regime. Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND) and Tech (XLK ABOVE TREND) showing relative strength while gold, silver and parts of the speculative complex (IBIT, ARKK) are in short-term CORRECTION and warrant monitoring.
